seoTitle: Buffy the Vampire Slayer Test: Which Character Are You? (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Buffy the Vampire Slayer test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Buffy, Willow, Xander, Giles, Cordelia, Angel, Spike, Anya or Faith — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the Slayer, the witch, or the guy with no powers and all the heart? Answer 12 everyday questions about friends, danger and doing the right thing, and find out which Buffy character you are.

characters.name: Buffy Summers
characters.title: The Slayer
characters.summary: Brave, loyal and carrying the weight of the world. You do what has to be done, and you still try to have a life.
description: Like Buffy, you carry a lot on your shoulders. She's the Slayer, one in a long line of girls chosen to fight the forces of evil.
You live by your own rules. Buffy has a personal rule against killing humans.
You still try to have a normal life. Buffy juggles slaying with school, friends and jobs, including a brief stint working construction with Xander.
characters.flaw: You take everything on yourself, and push people away when it gets hard.
characters.signature: A wooden stake, a quick comeback and a group of friends you'd die for.
characters.clashReason: they'd insist on handling it alone, then be annoyed you didn't help

characters.name: Willow Rosenberg
characters.title: The Witch
characters.summary: Smart, kind and more powerful than anyone expected. You started out shy, and you grew into someone nobody can ignore.
description: Like Willow, you grow into your power. She starts out as the shy, nerdy best friend, and becomes a powerful witch.
You stay kind. Willow keeps her humanity and her kindness to others throughout.
You love deeply. Willow falls for Tara, who she meets in a Wicca group.
characters.flaw: When you're hurt, you can go much too far.
characters.signature: A stack of notes, a nervous smile and more power than anyone realises.
characters.clashReason: they'd out-research you, then apologise for it

characters.name: Xander Harris
characters.title: The Heart
characters.summary: Loyal, funny and braver than you think. You've got no superpowers, just a lot of heart.
description: Like Xander, you've got no superpowers, just a lot of heart. He's Buffy's close friend, and the group's comic relief.
You keep everyone grounded. Xander gives the group an everyday point of view.
You've got a real job. Xander works in construction, and even ends up as Buffy's boss for a day.
characters.flaw: You worry you're not as special as everyone around you.
characters.signature: A bad joke, a hammer and a heart in the right place.
characters.clashReason: they'd make a joke when you wanted them to be serious

characters.name: Rupert Giles
characters.title: The Watcher
characters.summary: Wise, patient and quietly tough. You're the one who does the research, and the one everyone turns to.
description: Like Giles, you're the one who does the research. He's Buffy's Watcher, and the librarian at Sunnydale High.
You look after everyone. Giles becomes a father figure to Buffy and her friends.
You've got a wild past. As a young man, Giles experimented with dark magic, and earned the nickname "Ripper."
characters.flaw: You distrust anything new, especially technology.
characters.signature: A dusty book, a polite sigh and a past you'd rather not discuss.
characters.clashReason: they'd look at you over their glasses, and say nothing at all

characters.name: Cordelia Chase
characters.title: The Queen Bee
characters.summary: Confident, brutally honest and more loyal than you look. You say what everyone's thinking, and you turn out to be a good friend.
description: Like Cordelia, you say exactly what you think. She starts out as a popular, shallow cheerleader.
You come around. Cordelia becomes a reluctant ally to Buffy and her friends.
You find your purpose. Cordelia moves to L.A. to fight evil with Angel.
characters.flaw: You don't always think before you speak.
characters.signature: A perfect outfit, a brutal opinion and a surprisingly loyal heart.
characters.clashReason: they'd tell you exactly what's wrong with your outfit

characters.name: Angel
characters.title: The Brooder
characters.summary: Protective, intense and carrying a heavy past. You'd do anything to keep the people you love safe, even if it means keeping your distance.
description: Like Angel, you carry your past with you. He's a vampire whose soul was restored by a curse.
You protect people, even from a distance. Angel leaves Sunnydale for L.A. after season 3.
You get your own story. Angel goes on to star in his own spin-off series.
characters.flaw: You brood so much that people can't reach you.
characters.signature: A dark look, a heavy past and a lot of brooding.
characters.clashReason: they'd go quiet and brood, instead of talking to you

characters.name: Spike
characters.title: The Rebel
characters.summary: Bold, passionate and full of attitude. You never do anything by halves, and you love harder than anyone.
description: Like Spike, you've got serious attitude. He's a vampire known for his platinum hair, his duster coat and his catchphrase, "bloody hell."
You can change. Spike goes from major villain to comic relief to hero.
You go out a hero. Spike sacrifices himself in the final battle at the Hellmouth.
characters.flaw: You fall hard, and you never do anything by halves.
characters.signature: A long duster, a sarcastic grin and a lot of attitude.
characters.clashReason: they'd mock you, loudly, every chance they got

characters.name: Anya
characters.title: The Ex-Demon
characters.summary: Honest, direct and completely without a filter. You say what you're thinking, and you know exactly what things are worth.
description: Like Anya, you say exactly what you're thinking. She's a 1,120-year-old former vengeance demon, relearning how to be human.
You know the value of things. Anya discovers a love of money, and Giles hires her at the Magic Box.
You love with your whole heart. Anya's story centres on her relationship with Xander.
characters.flaw: You say things out loud that everyone else only thinks.
characters.signature: A cash register, a brutally honest comment and no filter at all.
characters.clashReason: they'd ask you, out loud, something nobody else would dare to

characters.name: Faith
characters.title: The Wild Card
characters.summary: Fearless, fun and impossible to tame. You live in the moment, and you'd rather run than let anyone see you hurting.
description: Like Faith, you live in the moment. She's a Slayer, and the wild, darker side of what a Slayer can be.
You've made big mistakes. Faith turns to murder, and joins forces with the Mayor.
You can turn it around. Faith is rehabilitated in L.A., and comes back to help fight the First Evil.
characters.flaw: You'd rather run than let anyone see you're hurting.
characters.signature: A wicked grin, a reckless plan and a night that never ends.
characters.clashReason: they'd drag you into trouble, then leave you to deal with it

questions.text: A friend asks what you think of their new haircut. It's bad. You...

options.text: Tell them it's a disaster. Someone has to
Say it's bad, then ask if they can get a refund
Find one nice thing to say about it
Make a joke, and hope they laugh too

questions.text: You've got a big exam tomorrow. Tonight you...

options.text: Study all night, and make colour-coded notes
Read three extra books on the subject, just in case
Go out. You'll wing it
Try to study, but end up dealing with an emergency

questions.text: Your idea of a perfect night out is...

options.text: Dancing until the club closes
A dive bar, loud punk music and trouble later
A quiet evening in. Nights out are overrated
Somewhere exclusive, where everyone notices your outfit

questions.text: Your new phone has a complicated setup. You...

options.text: Give up, and go back to your old one
Set it up in five minutes, then fix everyone else's
Pretend you understand it
Ask, out loud, why anyone needs a phone this complicated

questions.text: Someone you love is in serious danger, right now. You...

options.text: Put yourself between them and the danger, no question
Protect them from a distance, without them knowing
Charge in, swearing, and fight anything that moves
Grab whatever's nearby and help, even though you're terrified

questions.text: You did something really bad in the past. You...

options.text: Brood about it, and spend years trying to make up for it
Act like you don't care, and hope it goes away
Own it. You were bad, and you were good at it
Keep it to yourself, and hope nobody ever finds out

questions.text: You've got a crush, and it's obvious to everyone except them. You...

options.text: Act really weird around them, and hope they don't notice
Tell them, very directly, exactly what you want
Keep your distance. It's better for them
Fall completely, and make it everyone's problem

questions.text: You're handed a huge responsibility you never wanted. You...

options.text: Hate it, then do it anyway, because nobody else can
Run from it
Complain loudly, then turn out to be great at it
Accept it. Duty matters

questions.text: Your friends are having a huge argument. You...

options.text: Try to get everyone to go for pizza
Quietly talk to each of them on their own
Wait for them to calm down, then offer some sensible advice
Pick a side, and make sure everyone knows it

questions.text: You're offered a lot of money to do something a bit dodgy. You...

options.text: Ask how much, exactly
Take it. Rules are for other people
Say no. You've got enough problems already
Say no, and think about who it might hurt

questions.text: You're a teenager, and you find out you're the one person in the world chosen to fight vampires. You...

options.text: Fight them, and still try to make it to prom
Love it. Finally, something you're good at
Ask if there's any way to pass it on to someone else
Panic, then make a very detailed plan

questions.text: You're a vampire, and you've just got your soul back. You...

options.text: Hide away from everyone for a long, long time
Go a bit mad, then try to become someone worth loving
Ask whether you can have your old powers back instead
Ask your friends for help, and hope they still trust you
